title: Alphabet shares tumble in $500bn rout
summary: Alphabet admits that its 'AI mode' has hurt traditional search, as sales and profits undershot expectations. Shares fell in a $500bn rout. Summary based on the headline and blurb only.

title: Canada, Nvidia Back Cohere at Over $20 Billion Valuation

title: The Customer-Centric Agentic Enterprise

title: Druckenmiller backs push to bring risky perpetual futures to Wall Street

title: Paschi Investors Deal Crushing Blow to CEO in Win for Intesa
